title: Most Game Layoffs Came From Outside The Biggest Names
hook: The rest of gaming lost 12,000 jobs beyond Microsoft and Sony.
closing: Famous cuts were only the visible edge of an industry-wide employment collapse.
question: Has gaming become less stable?

segments.say: Game layoffs hit 14,800, showing the industry’s job losses accelerated instead of easing.
The rest of the industry lost 12,000 jobs, proving the damage reached far beyond headline companies.
